response.justification: The candidate is an experienced generalist software engineer (15+ years) with deep strength in web, Node.js/TypeScript, and DLang, but the resume shows almost no alignment with the core requirements of this role. Hands-on C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of professional C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work (only MySQL/MongoDB listed), and no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure — the RIDE Capital role was a Node/GraphQL fintech position, not capital markets C++ work. Strong engineering fundamentals, testing culture, and communication skills are evident, but they do not offset the mandatory skill gaps.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong testing/TDD and CI/CD discipline
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and course authoring
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago
No Fixed Income, derivatives, or investment banking/capital markets domain background
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development experience
